description: Search the public EverList catalog of bookable listings (events, classes, food, services, jobs, p2p). Free-text q plus optional filters: vertical, category, tags (comma-separated), date window from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), min_price/max_price, sort (date|price|newest). Returns matches with id, title, date, location, price, spots left. Next step: everlist_listing for one full record, then everlist_book. Storefront twin: search_products (same handler, Claude commerce contract name).

min_price.description: minimum price in major units (0 = free included)

sort.description: date | price | newest (invalid values are rejected)

name: everlist_search
